_comment: Central Texas seed list. Run `npm run probe` (free, no LLM calls) after editing: it verifies each URL and, when one is wrong, prints candidate council links scraped from that site's homepage. URLs marked verified below were confirmed OK by a probe run; the rest came from probe suggestions or still need confirmation. Counties use level 'county' with city set to '<Name> County' so the frontend's county matching resolves them. Local and county jurisdictions only: state legislators come from Open States (see the root README), not from scraping chamber roster pages. This file is no longer the only source of jurisdictions to scrape: run.js/probe.js (via seeds.js's loadJurisdictions()) merge it with the auto-generated config/seeds.discovered.json (see discover-jurisdictions.js) — entries here always win a conflict, so this file is now specifically for hand-vetted corrections/overrides, not the complete list.

_needs_verified_url.Luling: www.lulingtx.org does not resolve; the city's real domain is unknown. Removed until confirmed.
_needs_verified_url.Cedar Park: cedarparktexas.gov/government/city-council 404s and none of probe's homepage-link suggestions (Government hub, a Careers page, a news alert) was confidently the roster page itself — pipeline.js extracts from exactly the seeded URL with no further crawl, so a wrong guess here would silently keep returning 0 officials forever. Removed so discover-jurisdictions.js's own multi-hop roster crawl (findRosterPage()) can find the real page instead.
_needs_verified_url.Georgetown: georgetown.org does not resolve (wrong domain, real one unconfirmed). Removed so discoverJurisdictionSite() can recall + verify the actual homepage instead of us guessing one we can't fetch to check.
_needs_verified_url.Manor: cityofmanor.org is a bare homepage, not a roster page — every scrape found 0 officials there. Removed so discover-jurisdictions.js's roster crawl (which starts from exactly this homepage and hops onward) can find the real council page.
_needs_verified_url.Wimberley: cityofwimberley.com/27/Government is a generic department hub, not a roster page — every scrape found 0 officials there. Same fix as Manor: removed for the auto-discovery crawl to find the real page.
_needs_verified_url.note: Anything still failing after the next probe run needs its URL replaced from the probe suggestions.
